**Unofficial** Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric) port of [Mining & Placing Animations](https://github.com/Gauraaaaaaaa/MiningAndPlacingAnimations).

All credit for the mod goes to its original author, **[Gaura](https://github.com/Gauraaaaaaaa)**. This port is not made, endorsed or supported by them, so please report problems with it to [this fork's issues](https://github.com/signup098ezxs/MiningAndPlacingAnimations/issues), not to the original project. Official releases: https://modrinth.com/mod/mining_and_placing_animations

### Install

1. Download the `.jar` below (under **Assets**).
2. Put it in your `mods` folder, together with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 0.161.0+26.2 or newer.
3. Requires Minecraft **26.2**, Fabric Loader **0.19.5+** and Java 25. Optional: works with Sodium 0.9 and Iris 1.11.4.

### Found a bug?

Report it on this fork: open the [Issues tab](https://github.com/signup098ezxs/MiningAndPlacingAnimations/issues), click **New issue**, choose **Bug report (26.2 port)**, and attach your `logs/latest.log`. Please don't report it to the original project.

### What's in this port

- Updated to Minecraft 26.2's new rendering system (Fabric only).
- Smoother animations: keyframes are joined by smooth curves, the placing pop eases out, and mining animations loop without flickering.
- New optional `interpolation` and `easing` fields for animation files (see the README).
